extraction.name: LUMA
extraction.description: A multimodal dataset specifically designed for benchmarking multimodal leaming algorithms on uncertain data, including images, speech audio recordings, and text passages.
extraction.creator: Grigor Bezirganyan, Sana Sellami, Laure Berti-Équille, and Sébastien Foumier
extraction.citeAs: Grigor Bezirganyan, Sana Sellami, Laure Berti-Équille, and Sébastien Foumier. 2025. LUMA: A Benchmark Dataset for Leaming from Uncertain and Multimodal Data. In Proceedings of the 48th Intemational ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval (SIGIR ’25), July 13–18, 2025, Padua, Italy. ACM, New York, NY, USA, 10 pages. https://doi.org/10.1145/3726302.3730302
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Images were compiled from CIFAR 10/100, audio samples were extracted and validated from three diverse audio corpora, and text was generated using the Gemma-7B Instruct LLM.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: CIFAR-100 and CIFAR-10 datasets, The Spoken Wikipedia, LibriSpeech, and Mozilla Common Voice corpora.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Label noise was injected by randomly selecting a subset of samples, computing their deep feature representation, and reassigning the label of the class with the lowest mean distance.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Automatic validation was performed on audio samples to remove extreme cases, followed by manual validation to filter out false negatives.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotators were provided with an audio sample and asked if the audio was saying a specific word, with options of 'Yes' or 'No'.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Two annotations were collected per sample, achieving a 71.61% agreement rate. Samples with conflicting annotations were rejected.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: M.Sc. and PhD students, and professors with advanced to fluent English knowledge.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: OpenAI’s Whisper Large V3 model and Gemma-7B Instruct model
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset contains gender bias, particularly for the classes 'man', 'woman', 'boy', and 'girl'.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset may contain factual inaccuracies or biases due to the use of an LLM for text generation, and should not be used as a source of knowledge or information.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Benchmarking multimodal learning algorithms on uncertain data.

name.evidence: We propose LUMA, a unique multimodal dataset, featuring audio, image, and textual data from 50 classes, specifically designed for leaming from uncertain data.

description.evidence: To address this challenge, we introduce LUMA (Leaming from Uncertain and Multimodal data), a multimodal dataset specifically designed for benchmarking multimodal leaming algorithms on uncertain data. The dataset includes 101,000 images, 135,096 speech audio recordings, and 62,875 text passages...

rai:dataCollection.evidence: We compiled the images from the CIFAR 10/100 dataset [ 18], extracted, validated, and associated audio samples corresponding to the CIFAR image class labels from three diverse audio corpora [ 2,15,27], and generated the text modality based on the class labels using the Gemma-7B Instruct [25] Large Language Model (LLM).

rai:dataCollectionType.evidence: We compiled the images from the CIFAR 10/100 dataset [ 18], extracted, validated, and associated audio samples corresponding to the CIFAR image class labels from three diverse audio corpora [ 2,15,27], and generated the text modality based on the class labels using the Gemma-7B Instruct [25] Large Language Model (LLM).

rai:dataCollectionRawData.evidence: We compiled the images from the CIFAR 10/100 dataset [ 18], extracted, validated, and associated audio samples corresponding to the CIFAR image class labels from three diverse audio corpora [ 2,15,27]...

rai:dataManipulationProtocol.evidence: To inject label noise in a more structured manner, we randomly select a subset of samples based on a user-defined probability. For each selected sample, we compute its deep feature representation using modality-specific encoders... The sample is reassigned the label of the class with the lowest mean distance...

rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol.evidence: To remove such extreme cases in audio samples, we performed an automatic validation of the samples. Then, we filtered out the false negatives with manual validation for the negative predictions.

rai:dataAnnotationProtocol.evidence: The interface provided the audio sample, with the prompt "Is the audio saying the word below? (An extra ’s’ or ’es’ in the pronunciation is okay.)" and answer options of "Yes" or "No". We asked our colleagues (M.Sc. and PhD students, and professors) with advanced to fluent English knowledge to annotate the samples.

rai:dataAnnotationPlatform.evidence: We opted for Label Studio [ 31] to build the labeling interface.

rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis.evidence: In total, we collected 2 annotations per sample, from 17 annotators. We got 71.61% annotation agreement and accepted 5,027 samples, where both annotators confirmed the validity of the sample. Samples with conflicting annotations were rejected.

rai:annotationsPerItem.evidence: In total, we collected 2 annotations per sample, from 17 annotators.

rai:annotatorDemographics.evidence: We asked our colleagues (M.Sc. and PhD students, and professors) with advanced to fluent English knowledge to annotate the samples.

rai:machineAnnotationTools.evidence: The automatic validation was achieved with the OpenAI’s Whisper Large V3 model [ 29] for audio transcription... we asked the Gemma model to find out if the given text contains gender, racial, religious, or cultural biases.

rai:dataBiases.evidence: Particularly, we noticed a lots of gender bias for classes "man", "woman", "boy" and "girl".

rai:dataLimitations.evidence: Since textual data was generated using an LLM, we recognize that the dataset may contain factual inaccuracies, or biases, but our aim is to offer a benchmark to study uncertainty quantification in multimodal classification settings. LUMA shall not be used as a source of knowledge or information.

rai:dataUseCases.evidence: To address this challenge, we introduce LUMA (Leaming from Uncertain and Multimodal data), a multimodal dataset specifically designed for benchmarking multimodal leaming algorithms on uncertain data.
